verdict.rationale: The evidence shows interactive slash-command skills (grilling, TDD, triage) that the user invokes in an agent session; nothing documents scheduling or running automations autonomously in the background. The 'ready-for-agent' AFK label is only a triage state, and plugin self-updates are an adjacent install behavior, not user-defined automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
